tools.name: search_gyms
tools.description: Find gyms and studios (CrossFit, HYROX, fitness, yoga, pilates, boxing, martial arts, dance, climbing) in France and Europe, near a point or by name, city or postcode. Activity words in the query filter ('CrossFit Nice', 'yoga Lyon'); a style word (bikram, vinyasa, hatha, yin, reformer, lagree) stay

tools.name: get_gym
tools.description: Details of a gym. bookable: true: description, address, hours, sites, maps link and bookingUrl (the public booking page). bookable: false: the directory listing (url) and no booking link, whether the gym is claimed or not. Each gym includes, when Gymmy has it: full address, city, country, coordinate

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming classes of a bookable Gymmy gym (next 14 days): time, duration, spots left, and a booking link with the class already picked. Also the gym's address and maps link. Refuses a gym with bookable: false. Each gym includes, when Gymmy has it: full address, city, country, coordinates (geo), mapsU

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Memberships, class packs and trial offers of a bookable Gymmy gym, with prices in EUR and a direct sign-up link per offer. Also the gym's address and maps link. A gym with bookable: false returns its directory listing and no sign-up link. Each gym includes, when Gymmy has it: full address, city, cou

tools.name: start_trial
tools.description: Gives the link to book a trial class at a bookable Gymmy gym, with the trial offer and optionally the class already picked. The person opens it and confirms with their name and email; nothing is booked or charged by this tool. Refuses a gym with bookable: false. Each gym includes, when Gymmy has it:

tools.name: search_classes
tools.description: Bookable aggregator: search by sport (crossfit, hyrox, yoga, pilates, boxing / boxe, martial_arts / arts martiaux, dance / danse, climbing / escalade, padel), city and optional date and time. Gyms on Gymmy that accept visitors return their real free classes (spotsLeft and capacity from the planning)

tools.name: book_dropin
tools.description: Buys a trial, a single class or a class pack at a Gymmy gym and books the class in one go, for the signed-in person (any Gymmy account, no membership needed). Without confirm: returns a summary (price, class) and charges nothing. With confirm: true, first_name and last_name: returns a Stripe Checkou

tools.name: join_gym
tools.description: Signs the signed-in person up to a Gymmy gym's membership or class pack (from get_prices), paid on the gym's own Stripe Checkout page. Without confirm: returns a summary and charges nothing. With confirm: true, first_name and last_name: returns the payment link. checkout_status reports the payment.

tools.name: checkout_status
tools.description: Status of a purchase started with book_dropin or join_gym (ref): pending (checkout open), processing (bank debit), paid, free or failed, and whether the gym now shows in the person's Gymmy account. The widget polls it after the Stripe page opens. The booking is confirmed by the gym's Stripe webhook

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: Who is signed in on Gymmy: answers 'what is my Gymmy account', 'which gym am I connected to', 'what's my email', 'what's my name' or 'what's my member id'. Returns the account name, email, member id, membership status (plan and active, unpaid, paused, or coach/admin) and every linked gym with addres

tools.name: my_gyms
tools.description: Gyms the signed-in Gymmy member belongs to, with address, maps link, logo, phone, public email, website, opening hours and listing URL. A test gym hidden from search (such as an internal salle) is still returned when it is this member's gym. The person's name, email and member id come from get_my_ac

tools.name: my_bookings
tools.description: The signed-in member's upcoming booked and waitlisted classes (next 2 weeks), across all their Gymmy gyms (or one with gym). Each gym includes its address and maps link. Each gym includes, when Gymmy has it: full address, city, country, coordinates (geo), mapsUrl (Google Maps), directionsUrl, appleM

tools.name: my_schedule
tools.description: Classes for a week at the signed-in member's gyms (all of them, or one with gym), with the class ids book_class takes (classId), spots left and whether they are booked. Each gym includes its address and maps link. Each gym includes, when Gymmy has it: full address, city, country, coordinates (geo),

tools.name: book_class
tools.description: Books a class at one of the signed-in member's gyms with their own membership (or puts them on the waitlist when full, if the gym allows). Uses the gym's booking rules. No payment is taken here. The answer includes the gym's address and maps link. Each gym includes, when Gymmy has it: full address,

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels the signed-in member's booking (or waitlist spot) for a class. The gym's cancellation deadline applies; a late cancel may count as used. The answer includes the gym's address and maps link. Each gym includes, when Gymmy has it: full address, city, country, coordinates (geo), mapsUrl (Google

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_gyms, get_gym, get_schedule, get_prices, search_classes, get_my_account, my_gyms · Public sink: search_gyms, get_gym, get_schedule, get_prices, start_trial, search_classes, checkout_status, get_my_account, my_gyms, my_bookings, my_schedule, book_class, cancel_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_gyms, get_gym, get_schedule, get_prices, search_classes, get_my_account, my_gyms · Public sink: search_gyms, get_gym, get_schedule, get_prices, start_trial, search_classes, checkout_status, get_my_account, my_gyms, my_bookings, my_schedule, book_class, cancel_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
